title: Base guarded trader (Coinbase AgentKit)
summary: A Coinbase AgentKit agent on Base: the Sato Kit's tools reach AgentKit through one action provider. It reads Base market data (block, gas, Chainlink ETH/USD), a small Model names the AgentKit actions to call, and every intent goes through quote, prepare, simulate and a policy pre-flight that names the rule, limit and observed value of every refusal. Fixture mode needs no network and no key. It signs only on a local fork with a throwaway key or on Base Sepolia with a CDP smart wallet, never on mainnet, and execute needs a person's approval.

tests.description: The platform runs the fixture command over the shipped recordings (no network, no key) and checks out/report.json against schemas/output.json: exit 0, and the over-cap intent refused with its rule, limit and observed value.
The template's own tests. Recorded, never the verdict.

Nightly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: an anvil fork of Base at block 51800000 with recorded quotes; exact reads, an approve simulation, pre-flight outcomes through the AgentKit actions, and execute refused without an approve callback. Never broadcasts.

provenance.notes: Deterministic over fixtures. Same goal as base-guarded-trader/plain-ts, on Coinbase AgentKit through @satohub/kit/agentkit. AgentKit's built-in wallet-provider analytics call is turned off in src/agentkit.ts. Fork and testnet modes are opt-in and never run in the platform's offline test phase.
